answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable 5,000 POA bond before it may trade, like a timber merchant staking wood before a summit deal. The bond is locked 14 days and slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Faking 1,000 agents then locks 5,000,000 POA for two weeks, so the attack costs real capital instead of free copies - a pearl of a rule: cheap to join honestly, ruinously expensive to fake at scale.
